entities.note: 3x3 colour-9 block with one colour-4 'eye' pixel on the side it faces, at rows 15-17, cols 15-17 (top-left node of the maze), initially facing right (eye at (16,17))
3x3 colour-14 square at rows 45-47, cols 45-47 (bottom-right node, opposite corner of the maze)
black 3x3 nodes on a 6-px lattice inside rows 15-47, cols 15-47 (lattice rows/cols 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45; 7 of the 36 positions are missing); the player always rests on a node
3x3 colour-2 corridor blocks halfway between two nodes; a move is possible only where such a block exists
the colour-5 field everywhere else (letterbox around the 33x33 maze and the gaps between nodes): where no colour-2 block joins two nodes, that direction is blocked
row 63: colour 6 = remaining steps, black(0) eats in from the RIGHT (64 px = 50 presses, about 1.3 px per press); every press counts, accepted or not

rules.note: up one node (6 px, animated 1 px per frame) if a colour-2 corridor block lies directly above; the eye pixel turns to the top side; costs 1 step
down one node if a corridor block lies below; eye turns to the bottom side
left one node if a corridor block lies to the left; eye turns to the left side
right one node if a corridor block lies to the right; eye turns to the right side
a press towards a side with no colour-2 corridor changes nothing (not even the eye) but still costs 1 step (same for ACTION2/3/4)

goal.note: the level ends when the colour-9 block sits exactly on the colour-14 square (rows 45-47, cols 45-47); shortest corridor path is 18 moves, budget 50; no enemies at L1
